**irr 70（2026-08-20・irr=70 の二重読み。v9.9.144 の5点検問）**　《機構》工程への組込＋解約率・更新率の実数——500社超のチャネルパートナー(ERP／PM／EHR)への統合を会社自身が『harder to replace』と名指しし、離脱側の費用を『the significant time and resources it takes to switch to a different healthcare payments provider』と断定。裏づけの実数は Net Revenue Retention Rate 112.0%（FY2025）、初期契約は typically a two to three-year term　『However, we believe that due to the breadth, depth, and quality of our products, as well as the significant time and resources it takes to switch to a different healthcare payments provider, we will be able to retain our existing clients and upsell and cross-sell to them, as evidenced by our Net Revenue Retention Rate of 112.0%』（Item 1 事業／見出し『Our Clients』直後の顧客基盤の記述）——向きが正しい唯一の断定——費用と時間を負うのは**当社から他社へ移る顧客**。しかも保持率の実数(112.0%)を根拠に添えている　『Our solutions are integrated with a broad range of systems provided by over 500 channel partners, including ERP applications, as well as preventative maintenance ("PM") and electronic health record ("EHR") systems. This deep connectivity is an important point of differentiation and makes our solutions faster to implement, easier to use, and harder to replace.』（Item 1 事業／見出し『Key components of our platform』の箇条書き『Seamless integrations』）——摩擦の機構（工程への組込）を500社超という実数で名指しし、『harder to replace』と結論している　『Implementation of our solutions may also require other technology implementation or process changes by the client.』（Item 1A 事業等のリスク（導入の遅延））——導入・移行の負担が**顧客側**に生じることを明記。リスク要因の中にあるが向きは顧客側で正しい　『Our clients have no obligation to renew their subscriptions for our platform solutions after the initial term expires, which is typically a two to three-year term.』（Item 1 事業／『Our Clients』——上の断定の**直前の文**）——複数年(2〜3年)の初期契約という機構と、更新義務の不在という反証が同居する。85を否定し70に留める文　《反証（同じ原本に同居する）》『Our contracts generally provide for the automatic renewal for one-year subsequent terms, with the ability for our clients to terminate the contract with limited notice to us.』 ／ 『Generative AI may also lower barriers to entry, enabling new competitors to emerge more quickly.』 ／ 『large healthcare providers may have sufficient IT resources to develop and maintain proprietary internal systems, or to consider developing new custom systems』 ／ 『This ease of integration enables our clients to quickly realize value from our solutions while avoiding costly and distracting implementation processes associated with other types of software and support services.』　《射程》全社（『We have one business activity』＝単一セグメント。Subscription 50.8%（$558.4M）＋ Volume-based 48.6%（$534.8M）が同一プラットフォーム上・総売上 $1,099.3M。上位10社で売上の10.8%＝特定事業への偏りなし）　《検問と反証の経緯》【検問1・2・3＝○】原本(10-K FY2025・510,156字)に、向きの正しい積極的な主張が**独立に2本**ある。(a)『we believe that due to the breadth, depth, and quality of our products, as well as **the significant time and resources it takes to switch to a different healthcare payments provider**, we will be able to retain our existing clients』——主語は**当社を離れる顧客**で、ONTO型（当社が奪いにくい）でも自社取得の認証でも願望形でもない。(b)『Our solutions are integrated with a broad range of systems provided by **over 500 channel partners**, including ERP applications, as well as … PM … and … EHR … systems. This deep connectivity … makes our solutions … **harder to replace**』——摩擦の機構（工程への組込）を実数つきで名指し。加えて実数が2つ付く: **NRR 112.0%**（brief の『解約率・更新率の実数』）と『typically a **two to three-year** term』（複数年）。顧客側の負担も『Implementation of our solutions may also require **other technology implementation or process changes by the client**』と明記。

【★50 だと言える材料を探したが落とせなかった経緯】検問4の反証を5本掘り当てたが、いずれも70を消すには至らなかった——(a)『Our clients have **no obligation to renew** … with the ability for our clients to **terminate the contract with limited notice** to us』（no obligation to renew は3件）。だが**この文の直後に『However,』で上記(a)の摩擦の主張が続く**＝会社自身の結論は摩擦の側で、しかも数字を添えている。(b)『large healthcare providers may have sufficient IT resources to develop and maintain **proprietary internal systems**』＝顧客の内製。(c)『**Generative AI may also lower barriers to entry**』＋『EHR and PM vendors may integrate AI capabilities directly into their platforms』。(d)売り文句としての低摩擦『This ease of integration enables our clients to quickly realize value … while **avoiding costly and distracting implementation processes**』／『#1 in client satisfaction with **implementation time**』／実装料は**売上の1%未満**。(e)**RPO は $78.6M＋$37.8M＝$116.4M で売上の0.106倍**・67.5%が12ヶ月以内＝ADBE を50とした 0.94倍より遥かに弱い（ただしRPOは1年以下契約と series型の変動対価を定義上除くので、Volume-based 48.6%が構造的に入らない点は割り引いて読む）。⇒ **これらは85を確実に否定し、70を『高摩擦だが移行不能ではない』の位置に置くが、v9.9.144 が70に要求する『機構の名指し＋原本引用』は満たされたまま残る。**

【confidence を med にした理由】(b)の『harder to replace』は『Key components of our platform』の**強みの箇条書き**の中にあり、RMD を70→50 とした『strategy の箇条書き』の register に近い。単独なら弱いが、箇条書きの外にある(a)が費用と時間を顧客側の負担として述べ実数を伴うので、RMD（機構ゼロ）とは水準が違うと判断した。

【evidence_gap = true】台帳の `_meta.evidence.irr` は**空文字**で、根拠が一つも無い。値が何であれ v9.9.144 を満たしていない。今日の70はこの空白を原本の実文で初めて埋めたもの。
